text:
Type: tall white bookcase with crown molding
Use: displaying books and decor; living room, home office, library
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: white painted wood-based panels, beadboard-look grooved back, decorative molded top and plinth
Colors: soft white
Shape: tall open bookcase with adjustable shelves, carved shelf brackets, crown cornice and shaped base, vertical grooved back, substantial visual weight
Feel: elegant, bright, timeless, stately
Goes with: white or cream walls, dark wood floors, blue or grey accents; traditional, classic or farmhouse living rooms and studies

product.name: LIATORP
product.description: Cornice and plinth rail help create a uniform expression when two or more units are connected together.
